description: Reproducible audit and pending-review candidate contract for the purchased S&P 500 historical constituent packages. Existing approved S&P outputs are not modified, source prices are not copied, and no output is approved automatically.
source_root: data/2026-08-05多个数据包_rethink/标普 500 成分股
snapshot_token_interpretation: pending_review; the filename token is not treated as proven acquisition or market as-of metadata

calendar.name: XNYS
calendar.reason: The checked-in XNYS.csv begins in 1993, while this source has membership observations from 1990.

split_only.path: data/2026-08-05多个数据包_rethink/标普 500 成分股/标普 500 成分股-仅拆股调整_20260804.zip

split_and_dividend.path: data/2026-08-05多个数据包_rethink/标普 500 成分股/标普 500 成分股-拆股及股息调整_20260804.zip

source_root_other_evidence.path: data/2026-08-05多个数据包_rethink/标普 500 成分股/扫码添加企微，获取更多优惠.jpg
source_root_other_evidence.treatment: immutable_external_evidence; not interpreted as provider or license metadata

membership_contract.interval_representation: Maximal runs of observed InIndex=1 rows, preserving gaps in price observations as reported quality warnings.
membership_contract.point_in_time_use: Use the membership state known before the decision timestamp; absent independent announcement-time evidence, lag observed effective membership by one XNYS session.
membership_contract.left_censoring: The first observed 1 on 1990-01-02 does not prove the true admission date and this package does not cover the full index history.
membership_contract.right_censoring: A final observed 1 is only valid through the source coverage end.
membership_contract.daily_representation: The checked-in membership_intervals.csv plus the registry-bounded exchange_calendars XNYS schedule unambiguously generates each daily member set.

identity_contract.primary_record: Each source CSV member is a separate candidate security record.
identity_contract.security_id: Deterministic SHA256-derived ID from the exact source filename; IDs do not imply corporate continuity.
identity_contract.dated_suffix: A trailing -YYYYMM is preserved in source_symbol and source_file and removed only for display_ticker. It describes the final price month in this package, not necessarily the index exit month.
identity_contract.rename_policy: Do not create predecessor/successor links, including ticker changes, mergers, bankruptcies, or reused tickers, without primary evidence and explicit review.
identity_contract.share_class_policy: Keep separate files and share classes separate, including GOOG/GOOGL, BRK.B and BF.B. Same company name is not a merge key.

BRK.B.note: Berkshire Hathaway B line retained exactly as supplied; no BRK.A record is fabricated.

BF.B.note: Brown-Forman B line retained exactly as supplied; share-class continuity remains pending review.

ECHO.note: The source uses ECHO for EchoStar while the March 2026 S&P announcement used SATS; no automatic ticker-history rewrite is made.

identity_review_special_cases.GOOG_GOOGL: kept as separate Alphabet share-class securities
identity_review_special_cases.META_FB: META source identity retained; no FB record fabricated from backfilled source fields
identity_review_special_cases.BKNG_PCLN: BKNG source identity retained; no PCLN record fabricated from backfilled source fields
identity_review_special_cases.BRK.B: retained as a separate supplied share line; BRK.A is not fabricated
identity_review_special_cases.BF.B: retained as a separate supplied share line
identity_review_special_cases.ECHO_SATS: source ECHO and official-announcement SATS difference remains an explicit identity review
identity_review_special_cases.dated_suffixes: preserved in source_symbol; display ticker is presentation-only and suffix month is not treated as index exit

member_count_explanation: S&P 500 的名义目标是 500 家公司，不等于任何时点都必须正好有 500 条上市证券线。S&P DJI 允许符合条件的公开多股类分别纳入，公司行动和过渡日期也可能临时增加或减少证券线。因此本包的 498–507 只不能直接判为错误；但所有非 500 区间和未能与公司行动对应的日期仍需保留为待审证据，不能用方法论一概豁免。

official_ticker_difference.SATS: source uses ECHO; identity pending review

reviewed_points: publicly listed multiple share-class lines may be included separately
spin-offs and index committee maintenance can create security-line transitions
official description says the index includes 500 leading companies
